name: Phone Lookup

name: Send SMS Message { json }
purpose: Sends an SMS: loads the ChatMessage and its Chat record by ActivityMessageId, takes the message text and the phone list, builds the Twilio form body (To, From from the system setting, Body, all URL-encoded) and POSTs to api.twilio.com Messages.json with the account SID and auth token as basic auth, through "HTTP ( {request} )" (345). On HTTP code 400 sets StatusFailedInd, otherwise StatusAcceptedInd and the Twilio message sid in ExternalMessageId. Returns the Chat Id. Runs inside the Start Transaction / Save Transaction Result / End Transaction wrapper (scripts 28, 29, 31); the DBTransactions record carries the keys and setting a "ONE" field on the related record locks or creates it.
